_comment: Hand-curated from the archive's own texts (material metadata, author essays, event and institution descriptions). 'aliases' are regular expressions matched against those texts to link each entity to materials, authors and events. Only facts stated in the archive are recorded here. Entities and people with 'sources' were added from the archive's PDFs (catalogues and books); each source gives the material, the PDF page (1-based) and what the PDF states there. 'materialPeople' maps a material to roles stated in its PDF (participants, curators, text authors, credits).
